title.pinyin: Nǐ chuān de tài shǎo le

instruction.hanzi: 给下面的词语选择对应的图片
instruction.english: Match the pictures with the words/phrases.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ měi tiān zǎoshang jǐ diǎn qǐ chuáng?
dialogue.english: When do you get up every morning?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ bǐ wǒ zǎo qǐ yí ge xiǎoshí.
dialogue.english: You get up one hour earlier than I do.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 我睡得也早,我每天晚上十点就睡觉。早睡早起身体好。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ shuì de yě zǎo, wǒ měi tiān wǎnshang shí diǎn jiù shuì jiào. Zǎo shuì zǎo qǐ shēntǐ hǎo.
dialogue.english: I go to bed early too — at 10pm every night. Early to bed, early to rise is healthy.

newWords.english: used after a verb or adjective to introduce a complement of result or degree

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 再来点儿米饭吧,你吃得太少了。
dialogue.pinyin: Zài lái diǎnr mǐfàn ba, nǐ chī de tài shǎo le.
dialogue.english: Have more rice — you've eaten too little.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 不少了,今天吃得很好,太谢谢你了。
dialogue.pinyin: Bù shǎo le, jīntiān chī de hěn hǎo, tài xièxie nǐ le.
dialogue.english: Not a little, actually. I've enjoyed the meal a lot. Thanks so much.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ zuò fàn zuò de zěnmeyàng?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 不怎么样,我妻子比我做得好。
dialogue.pinyin: Bù zěnmeyàng, wǒ qīzi bǐ wǒ zuò de hǎo.
dialogue.english: Not very well — my wife cooks better than me.

title.english: At the door of the house

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.pinyin: Xià xuě le, jīntiān zhēn lěng.
dialogue.english: It's snowing. It's really cold today.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.pinyin: Yǒu líng xià shí dù ba?
dialogue.english: The temperature must be about minus 10 degrees, right?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 是啊,你穿得太少了,我们进房间吧。
dialogue.pinyin: Shì a, nǐ chuān de tài shǎo le, wǒmen jìn fángjiān ba.
dialogue.english: Yes. You're wearing too little. Let's go inside the house, OK?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 我弟弟让我帮他找个房子,现在他家离公司有点儿远。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ dìdi ràng wǒ bāng tā zhǎo ge fángzi, xiànzài tā jiā lí gōngsī yǒudiǎnr yuǎn.
dialogue.english: My younger brother asked me to find him an apartment. He now lives a bit far from the company.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.pinyin: Zhù de yuǎn zhēn de hěn lèi!
dialogue.english: It's really exhausting to live far away.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 是啊,他也希望能住得近一点儿。
dialogue.pinyin: Shì a, tā yě xīwàng néng zhù de jìn yìdiǎnr.
dialogue.english: True. He also wants to live nearer.

explanation.hanzi: 程度补语是用来表示程度的,在形式上常用结构助词"得"连接程度补语。如果有宾语,要把宾语提前,或者重复动词。否定形式:V+得+不+Adj。疑问形式:V+得+Adj+不+Adj。
explanation.english: A complement of degree describes the extent of something. The particle 得 links the verb (or adjective) to the complement. If the verb has an object, put the object first, or repeat the verb (V O V 得 Adj). Negative: V 得 不 Adj. Yes/no question: V 得 Adj + 不 + Adj.

examples.pinyin: Tā (shuō) Hànyǔ shuō de hěn hǎo.
Wǒ xiě Hànzì xiě de bù hǎo.
examples.english: I don't write Chinese characters well.

examples.pinyin: Jiějie chàng gē chàng de búcuò.
examples.english: My elder sister sings pretty well.

examples.pinyin: Tā shuō de hǎo bu hǎo?
Nǐ zhù de yuǎn bu yuǎn?

explanation.hanzi: 如果动词带程度补语,"比"可以放在动词前,也可放在补语前。两种结构通用。
explanation.english: When a verb has a complement of degree, "比" can come before the verb (A 比 B V 得 Adj) or before the complement (A V 得 比 B Adj). Both forms are equivalent.

examples.pinyin: Tā xué de bǐ wǒ hǎo.
Jiějie pǎo de bǐ wǒ kuài.
examples.english: Elder sister runs faster than me.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ qīzi zuò de bǐ wǒ hǎo.
examples.english: My wife cooks better than me.
